reviewed_by: Codex focused review of Nebula settings assistant worktree
reason: The change adds a shell-level settings assistant, authenticated Core control-session lookup, browser theme action, Core settings catalog, post-tool preferences, listed default-model changes for provider and harness turns, and per-turn cloud tool-result consent. The follow-up adds Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a newline, an immediate Settings lens for explicit open commands, provider low effort, and advertised harness low/fast runtime choices. Select the exact service, action, and component tests plus the assistant journey on eight browser profiles.
exclusions: No native code changed. Unrelated Python and frontend suites, all other Playwright journeys, full suites, and physical-device tests are excluded. This selection does not establish real-Core inference or physical-device acceptance; those require separate evidence before a completion claim.
